about_the_game:
The Gates of Hell have burst open.
Relentless hordes flood the world — from rabid hellhounds to towering archdemons. With every minute, chaos creeps closer… You must survive, adapt, and carve your own path to victory.

7 unique classes: Warrior, Mage, Lord, Artisan, Leader, Necromancer, and Peasant. From brutal combat to dark necromancy — each class unlocks a distinct path to triumph.

Every choice matters:

  • Will you risk the fog of war for epic loot or play it safe clearing secure regions?

  • Buy, seize, or forge the gear you need?

  • Crush your foes, bribe them, or slip by unseen?

  • Strengthen your allies or focus all power on yourself?

Core mechanics:

  • Exploration & combat: journey through a procedurally generated world, uncover ruins and dungeons, and battle the forces of Hell.

  • Economy & construction: gather rare materials, build, upgrade structures, and trade to gain the upper hand.

  • Squad & progress: recruit allies, empower your party, and develop unique skills.

  • Equipment & magic: forge legendary weapons, enhance them, and unleash devastating spells to turn the tide of battle.

Paths to victory: Conquer through strength, magic, economy, or cunning craftsmanship — the choice is yours. Will you be the one to seal the Gates of Hell?

Enjoy Sandbox mode at your own pace, or test your limits in Nightmare mode, where even starting as a humble peasant can become a fatal mistake.

Add to your Wishlist — and rise as the hero who will close the Gates of Hell!

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 18.04 LTS or newer (64-bit)
  • Processor: Any dual core
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics, 512 MB VRAM
  • Storage: 250 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Resolution: 1280×720 or higher
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.05 LTS or newer (64-bit)
  • Processor: Dual core 2.5 GHz or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated graphics, 1 GB VRAM
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Resolution: 1920×1080

short_description: Fantasy strategy RPG with roguelike elements. A game about choice: every mechanic is an alternative to another. Fight or bribe, craft or trade, build or cast. Find your own path and reach victory.
